ADDED TO UNCONTESTED CALENDAR FOR (Amended) Order To Show Cause For Change Of Name
Off Calendar Jul-29-2004 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for OSC hearing for Change of Name.
Dept. 218, Comm. Sue Kaplan, Clerk: S. Ravinantapricha, CSR: Yvonne Lee.
Petitioner: Gordon Lee Goode, present in pro per, was sworn and examined.
It appears to the satisfaction of the Court that all the allegations in the petition are true, correct, and sufficient and that the petition should be granted.
The Court grants the petition for change of name to: Gordon Lee Goode-Hanna.
Decree signed in open court.

ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar May-18-2004 Off Calendar
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for hearing this day.
Commissioner: Sue Kaplan, Clerk: S. Ravinantapricha/Marta Vallejo , CSR: Yvonne Lee
Matter taken off calendar, Petitioner to file Amended Order to Show Cause and get a new date and re-publish (one publication per person with correct name on each)
